section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a study that developed Brazilian Portuguese translations of the Caregiver Eating Messages Scale (CEMS) and the Intuitive Eating Scale-2 (IES-2), and assessed their psychometric properties in Brazilian adults. A total of 288 participants completed these scales, along with the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) and a demographic questionnaire. The study found adequate psychometric properties for the CEMS and IES-2, including factorial, convergent, and discriminant validity, as well as reliability, and also examined correlations with BAS scores and body mass index.
